title: oxydectes procumbens
intro: Oxydectes procumbens, commonly known as Wild Yam, is a plant species that belongs to the Dioscoreaceae family. The health benefits of Wild Yam include its ability to alleviate menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with PMS, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Wild Yam include its anti-inflammatory, anti-spasmodic, and estrogenic properties, which can help to calm the nervous system and balance hormone levels. The bioactive constituents of Wild Yam include diosgenin, a steroidal saponin that is responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds like dioscin and diosbulbin.
